```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync

      - name: Run Ruff on memory-mcp
        run: uv run ruff check memory-mcp

      - name: Run tests on memory-mcp
        run: uv run pytest -v memory-mcp

      - name: Run Ruff on wifi-cam-mcp
        run: uv run ruff check wifi-cam-mcp

      - name: Check README links
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v1
        with:
          args: '--verbose --no-progress README.md'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
